summary: The note describes the facelift of the Lexus RX, designed through late 2010, patented in January 2011 and unveiled at the March 2012 Geneva Motor Show. It added new wheels, interior colors, lamps, grilles and LED running lights, plus a new F Sport variant. Worldwide sales began in April 2012, with F Sport variants following in July 2012.
one_line: The 2012 Lexus RX facelift, unveiled at the Geneva Motor Show, brought new styling, LED lights, Enform telematics and the F Sport variant.
key_facts: The Lexus RX facelift was designed through late 2010.
The facelift was patented on 7 January 2011 under design registration number 001845801 - 0004.
The facelift was unveiled at the March 2012 Geneva Motor Show.
The facelift brought new wheels, interior colors, new head and tail lamps and new grilles to the Lexus RX.
New LED running lights were introduced with the facelift.
The Lexus RX F Sport was introduced with a honeycomb grille, 8 - speed automatic transmission, and a unique sporty interior.
In the US, the new Lexus RX uses the Lexus Enform telematics system.
Lexus Enform includes the Safety Connect SOS system and Shazam tagging.
Worldwide sales of the RX 350 and RX 450h began in April 2012.
Sales of the F - Sport variants began in July 2012.
